g.text: "message": "This work requires platform credits. Add credits or contact your organization administrator. Platform credits are re
quired for this work; changing iterations or model-step limits does not resolve that requirement. Check the project's organization
in MCPJam under Organizations > Billing. If you are the owner, review the balance and the recovery options available to your plan
; top-ups may require an upgrade, and enterprise arrangements may require support. If you are a member or cannot manage billing, a
sk the organization owner to resolve it. Keep your suite and retry the original task only after the account issue is resolved. Thi
s response does not establish the available balance or expected cost.",
